daily.title: After Losing the GMO Race, Embrapa Wants to Compete in Gene Editing
daily.summary: After losing ground to multinational companies in the development of genetically modified crops, Embrapa wants to play a significant role in the soybean supply chain through new technologies. That is the assessment of Adilson de Oliveira Junior, the new head of Embrapa's soybean unit, who takes office this Monday (16).
